::: {.project}
### Mapping the space of altered states of consciousness

A preregistered study aimed at an empirically grounded classification of pharmacologically induced altered states. Participants (n = 739) rated the subjective dissimilarity between pairs of vividly remembered experiences associated with different psychoactive substances, and we modelled these ratings as distances in a geometric space using multidimensional scaling, complemented by PCA, UMAP and t-SNE. The first dimension separates ordinary and depressant- or stimulant-induced states from psychedelic and dissociative ones, the second spans the inhibition–stimulation axis.

[With Gacka and Orłowski · manuscript in preparation · [code and data](https://github.com/Pawel-Motyka/MDS_ASC)]{.meta}
:::

::: {.project}
### Simulated hallucinations in virtual reality

An immersive VR platform for presenting phenomenologically distinct visual hallucinations at graded intensities, used to measure their subjective and physiological effects and to study altered perception under experimental control.

[With Gacka, Ayres, Karasek, Pochwatko and Suzuki · presented at ASSC 28 and Models of Consciousness 6 (2025)]{.meta}
:::

::: {.project}
### Sensorimotor regularities and conscious access

A VR paradigm combining sensorimotor control tasks with continuous flash suppression to test whether objects whose motion depends lawfully on one's actions gain faster access to awareness than objects moving randomly.

[With Schwartzman, Seth and Suzuki · [Consciousness and Cognition (2025)](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.concog.2025.103934)]{.meta}
:::
